description: move_layer for MANY layers in ONE call: each entry sets one layer's static base (x/y/width/height/rotation/scale/opacity, same fields and rules as move_layer). All or nothing: an invalid entry rejects the whole call. This is how you PLACE many layers at once (scatter fifty duplicates, lay out a grid, re-flow a set); placement is static, so never use set_keyframes_batch for it — a keyframe is animation, and one keyframe per layer is a hidden constant.

layers.description: One entry per layer, each with move_layer's fields.

clear_animation.description: As in move_layer: true makes each static value passed replace that property's keyframe track (how layers placed by keyframes are re-placed statically).

elementId.description: video.<id>, image.<id>, shapes.<id>, text.<id>, or group.<id>.

x.description: Centre x in the element's own frame (canvas coords at root).

y.description: Centre y in the element's own frame (canvas coords at root).

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.
